source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.3

data.summary:
This model always begins the battle in Reserves:

- neither it nor units embarked in it count towards the limit on how many units may start in Reserves
- it may arrive during the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases in battle rounds 1-3, regardless of mission rules
- units embarked in it may disembark once it is on the battlefield, but must be placed over 9" from every enemy model
